items.docs: Lists all persons in the Pure instance. If additional filtering of the amount of persons returned, see the POST version which supports additional filtering.

Lists persons in the Pure instance, similar to the GET version, instead of using parameters to alter the response, an XML document is posted with the request. The XML document contains fields for all the parameters available for the GET version, but also additional filtering options. For documentation of the XML format see Person documentation.
